claim: Domain-specific knowledge injection causes a degradation in general capabilities due to domain shift.
falsifier: Inject domain-specific knowledge into a general LLM via post-training and measure performance on a general benchmark before and after; verify a decrease attributable to domain shift.

conditions: domain shift between general and domain-specific data
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (FitOne-8B based on Qwen3-8B), task (SFC certification exams vs. General-Bench), and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Domain-specific knowledge injection–general capabilities boundary

claim: For protein loop prediction, enumerative all-atom search can solve cases that are intractable to coarse-grained or stochastic methods, such as loops containing both cis and trans prolines or loops in protein/RNA interfaces.
falsifier: Select a set of loop prediction problems known to be challenging for coarse-grained methods and apply enumerative all-atom search; compare success rates.

conditions: loops with complex features (e.g., cis/trans prolines)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific loop cases reported; the intractability of other methods may depend on loop length and side-chain treatment.

title: Enumerative all-atom search for successful prediction for previously
